title: Te Kaikōrero Kōura i te Koraha
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi puni nui o te koraha i roto i tētahi wā tatari me te koretake. Kua riro atu tētahi rangatira nui ki tētahi hui ki te Atua, ā, kua mahue iho tētahi hapori e hiahia ana ki tētahi mea hei pupuri. I roto i taua wā okiokinga korekore, ka hikoi whakamua tētahi tangata whakapati me ngā kupu whakaari kanapa me tētahi mea hanga mohio e ahua ora ana.
clues: I roto ahau i te hunga i wehe atu i Ihipa me Mohi, me te mātakitaki i te wehenga o te moana hei mawhiti mō mātou.
I mātakitaki ahau i te haerenga o tō mātou rangatira ki te maunga mō ngā pō e whā tekau ki te tiki aratohu.
I kohia e au ngā whakapaipai mai i te iwi, ā, i whakairohia e au ki ōku ake ringaringa.
Na hanga ana e ahau tetahi kuao kau, he tangi tangi, a karangatia ana te iwi ki reira.
I tangohia e ahau tētahi ringa puehu i te ara o te karere, ā, maka ana e ahau ki runga ki taku i hanga ai.
I tū atu ahau ki te aroaro o Mohi, ā, i whakahengia ahau kia mea atu 'kaua e pā mai ki ahau' engari kia noho motuhake, me te whakarite kia hui te wā whakawa.

outcome.answer: Ka whakahēngia kia kī atu 'kaua e pā mai ki ahau' i a ia e noho motuhake ana, e tatari ana kia whakawakia

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
